# Web Component Widgets

This directory contains the built web component files.

## Files are generated by:

```powershell
.\start-webcomponents.ps1
```

or

```powershell
.\build-webcomponents.ps1
```

## Contents (after build):

- `shell-widget.js` - Shell remote web component
- `products-widget.js` - Products remote web component  
- `contact-widget.js` - Contact remote web component
- `angular-webpack-widget.js` - Angular (Webpack) remote web component
- `angular-vite-widget.js` - Angular (Vite) remote web component
- `vue-widget.js` + `vue-widget.css` - Vue remote web component

All files are copied from the central `widgets/` directory at the project root.
